name: First Dance Wedding and Social Dance Studio
aliases: First Dance - Wedding and Social Dance Studio
parkingNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible parking lot.
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking lot and restroom.
reviewNotes:
Brands itself "First Dance Wedding"; formerly Dance Obsession (Barney & Debbie).

Directory research 2026-10-04: Hours conflict on the studio's own site: the visible contact block says Mon 1-6 PM, Tue-Fri 1-9 PM, Sat by appointment, while hidden schema data says Mon-Fri 3-10 PM and Sat 11 AM-4 PM; we used the visible text (it also matches the map listing). Socials and parties run later in the evening (7:30-10 PM). Facebook: the only page found is the old 'Dance Obsession Ballroom Studio' page (https://www.facebook.com/danceobsessionballroom/) at the same address; not linked from the new site, so not recorded; owner may want to confirm. The site's text line (877) 611-5114 is not recorded as the main phone. Two other large images on the site are stock photos (a crowd from above, a wedding bouquet) and an AI-made background, so they were skipped. The logo is the site icon (270 px); no separate header logo image was found.
hours: Mon 1 PM-6 PM; Tue-Fri 1 PM-9 PM; Sat by appointment
description: A ballroom and social dance studio on Hempstead Turnpike in Farmingdale, open since 1986 and formerly called Dance Obsession. It teaches wedding first dances, ballroom, Latin, salsa, bachata, hustle and Argentine tango, and holds group-class-plus-social dance parties on its wood floor.
